```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(targets)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(hmmTMB))

## Paths work both from the project root (tar_make) and from quarto_reports/ (manual render).
root_path  <- if (dir.exists("_targets")) "." else ".."
store_path <- file.path(root_path, "_targets")
r_path     <- file.path(root_path, "r")

## season_info() labels seasons; hindcast_auc() scores the hindcast; build_risk_grid_newdata() and
## scale_covariates() rebuild the forecast grid exactly as the risk maps do.
source(file.path(r_path, "a_season_info.R"))
source(file.path(r_path, "e_score_plague_hindcast.R"))
source(file.path(r_path, "e_build_risk_grid_newdata.R"))
source(file.path(r_path, "e_scale_covariates.R"))

tar_load(
  c(
    fit_zones_sf, aus_shp, prediction_region_sf,
    hmm_data, plague_hmm, plague_hmm_unsupervised, plague_hmm_ppc, plague_hmm_pseudores,
    hmm_observation_model, plague_transition_enter, plague_transition_leave, plague_transition_leave_unsupervised,
    plague_risk_map_supervised, plague_risk_map_unsupervised,
    plague_risk_map_uncertainty_supervised, plague_risk_map_uncertainty_unsupervised,
    plague_risk_map_nowcast_supervised, plague_risk_map_nowcast_unsupervised,
    yearly_plague_occurrence, recent_plague_maps, recent_plague_maps_map, mutze_plague_maps,
    rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak, gpp_rolling_raster_6, soil_moisture_anomaly_raster,
    gpp_rolling_raster_6_nowcast, soil_moisture_anomaly_raster_nowcast,
    gpp_rolling_anomaly_raster_12, gpp_rolling_anomaly_raster_3, min_temp_rolling_anomaly_raster_3,
    min_temp_seasonal_end_month, soil_group_raster,
    plague_hindcast_supervised, plague_hindcast_unsupervised,
    plague_hindcast_scores_supervised, plague_hindcast_scores_unsupervised
  ),
  store = store_path
)

## The two models compared throughout: with and without the plague anchors (the unsupervised exit
## formula omits the soil-group terms, which it can't identify without anchors).
model_variants <- list(
  Supervised   = list(hmm = plague_hmm, risk_map = plague_risk_map_supervised,
                      risk_map_uncertainty = plague_risk_map_uncertainty_supervised,
                      risk_map_nowcast = plague_risk_map_nowcast_supervised,
                      hindcast = plague_hindcast_supervised, hindcast_scores = plague_hindcast_scores_supervised),
  Unsupervised = list(hmm = plague_hmm_unsupervised, risk_map = plague_risk_map_unsupervised,
                      risk_map_uncertainty = plague_risk_map_uncertainty_unsupervised,
                      risk_map_nowcast = plague_risk_map_nowcast_unsupervised,
                      hindcast = plague_hindcast_unsupervised, hindcast_scores = plague_hindcast_scores_unsupervised)
)
model_colours <- c(Supervised = "#2166ac", Unsupervised = "#e08214")

## Each transition covariate's raster, named by its hmm_data column (as the risk-map targets use them).
covariate_rasters <- list(
  rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak = rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak,
  gpp_anomaly                  = gpp_rolling_anomaly_raster_12,
  gpp_rolling6                 = gpp_rolling_raster_6,
  min_temp                     = min_temp_seasonal_end_month,
  gpp_rolling3_anomaly         = gpp_rolling_anomaly_raster_3,
  soil_moisture_anomaly        = soil_moisture_anomaly_raster,
  min_temp_rolling3_anomaly    = min_temp_rolling_anomaly_raster_3,
  soil_group                   = soil_group_raster
)

## Readable names for every covariate shown in tables and figures.
covariate_labels <- c(
  rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak = "Rainfall whiplash", gpp_anomaly = "GPP anomaly (12-month)",
  gpp_rolling6 = "GPP (6-month)", min_temp = "Minimum temperature (°C)",
  gpp_rolling3_anomaly = "GPP anomaly (3-month)", soil_moisture_anomaly = "Soil-moisture anomaly",
  min_temp_rolling3_anomaly = "Min-temp anomaly (3-month)", soil_group = "Soil group",
  baseline = "Baseline (intercept + AE zone)",
  season = "Season", crop_group_trap_det = "Crop group (trap visit)", crop_group_det = "Crop group",
  crop_stage_det = "Crop stage", soil_type_det = "Soil order", ae_zone_adj = "Adjusted AE zone",
  trap_subregion = "GRDC subregion", gpp_finescale = "Fine-scale GPP", soil_moisture = "Soil moisture",
  cropping_system = "Cropping system"
)
label_of <- function(v) ifelse(v %in% names(covariate_labels), covariate_labels[v], v)

## Hazard palette for risk (calm sage to brick red), shared with the project's other risk outputs.
hazard_colors <- c("#3F5B45", "#7C8C43", "#C99A34", "#BE5F2C", "#7A2626")
risk_scale <- scale_fill_gradientn(colors = hazard_colors, limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent,
                                   breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.2, 0.5, 1), trans = "sqrt", name = "Probability")

## Map layers in WGS84: national outline and fitted AE zones.
aus_sf <- st_as_sf(aus_shp) |> st_transform(4326)
fit_zones_ll <- st_transform(fit_zones_sf, 4326)
prediction_region_ll <- st_transform(prediction_region_sf, 4326)

## The four chew-card streams share every coefficient, so chewcard_count stands in for all four.
chewcard_streams <- c("chewcard_count", "chewcard_block2", "chewcard_block3", "chewcard_block4")

## AE zones (transitions) and adjusted AE zones (burrow/chew-card zone effects).
zone_levels <- levels(hmm_data$ae_zone)
adj_zone_levels <- levels(hmm_data$ae_zone_adj)
season_order <- c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter", "Spring")

## Mann-Whitney AUC: probability a positive case outranks a negative one.
auc_fn <- function(yes, no) {
  r <- rank(c(yes, no))
  (sum(r[seq_along(yes)]) - length(yes) * (length(yes) + 1) / 2) / (length(yes) * length(no))
}
fmt2 <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
pct <- function(x, acc = 0.1) scales::percent(x, accuracy = acc)
## "a, b and c" for lists in the text.
and_join <- function(x) if (length(x) <= 1) x else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])

## A grid map of one value column, with the national outline.
grid_map <- function(df, fill_col, fill_scale, title = NULL) {
  xr <- range(df$x); yr <- range(df$y); pad <- 0.6
  ggplot() +
    # geom_raster fills the regular 0.1 degree grid without the hairline gaps geom_tile leaves between rows.
    geom_raster(data = df, aes(x, y, fill = .data[[fill_col]])) +
    geom_sf(data = aus_sf, fill = NA, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.6) +
    fill_scale +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(xr[1] - pad, xr[2] + pad), ylim = c(yr[1] - pad, yr[2] + pad), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(1.4, "cm"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10.5))
}

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: model-helpers
#| include: false

## One typical row of a data frame, for predictions at fixed conditions: each numeric column's median
## (0 if it has no values), each factor's most common level (levels kept), any other column's first
## value. rows restricts which rows the typical values come from (e.g. one stream's surveys).
typical_row <- function(data, rows = rep(TRUE, nrow(data))) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data)[rows, , drop = FALSE]
  out <- lapply(d, function(v) {
    if (is.numeric(v)) {
      m <- stats::median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
      return(if (is.na(m)) 0 else m)
    }
    if (is.factor(v)) {
      counts <- table(v)
      return(factor(if (sum(counts) > 0) names(which.max(counts)) else levels(v)[1], levels = levels(v)))
    }
    v[1]
  })
  ## The anchor column isn't a covariate.
  out$state <- NULL
  as.data.frame(out, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, optional = TRUE)
}

## hmmTMB's predict() with a 95% interval from 200 posterior draws, seeded so the report is reproducible.
predict_ci <- function(hmm, what, newdata) {
  set.seed(1)
  hmm$predict(what = what, newdata = newdata, n_post = 200)
}

## The AE zone whose supervised intercept deviations (entering plus leaving) are closest to zero, so
## its curves are closest to the pooled, zone-average curves.
re_sup <- plague_hmm$hid()$coeff_re()[, 1]
intercept_dev <- re_sup[grepl("s\\(ae_zone\\)\\.[0-9]+$", names(re_sup))]
dev_by_zone <- tapply(abs(intercept_dev), as.integer(sub(".*\\.", "", names(intercept_dev))), sum)
reference_zone <- zone_levels[as.integer(names(which.min(dev_by_zone)))]
common_soil_group <- names(which.max(table(hmm_data$soil_group)))

## Typical conditions for transition predictions: every covariate at its median, the reference zone and
## the most common soil group.
base_transition_row <- typical_row(hmm_data)
base_transition_row$ae_zone <- factor(reference_zone, levels = zone_levels)
base_transition_row$soil_group <- factor(common_soil_group, levels = levels(hmm_data$soil_group))

## Variables in a model's formula for one transition, a "_scaled" variable as its original covariate
## (curves vary covariates in real units and rescale them with the model's own constants).
transition_vars <- function(hmm, entering) {
  f <- hmm$hid()$formula()[if (entering) 1 else 2, if (entering) 2 else 1]
  setdiff(sub("_scaled$", "", all.vars(stats::as.formula(f))), c("ae_zone", "soil_group"))
}

## Transition-prediction rows: typical conditions with one covariate set to each of values.
transition_newdata <- function(hmm, cv, values, zone = reference_zone, soil = common_soil_group) {
  nd <- base_transition_row[rep(1, length(values)), , drop = FALSE]
  nd[[cv]] <- values
  nd$ae_zone <- factor(zone, levels = zone_levels)
  nd$soil_group <- factor(soil, levels = levels(hmm_data$soil_group))
  scale_covariates(nd, attr(hmm, "covariate_scaling"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: compute-forecast
#| include: false

## Forecast period: the latest period shared by the time-varying transition covariates, and the season after it.
latest_shared_period <- function(rasters) {
  periods <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(rasters, names))
  key <- as.integer(sub(".*_", "", periods)) * 100 + as.integer(sub("_.*", "", periods))
  periods[which.max(key)]
}
period_seasons <- function(period) {
  info <- season_info(as.Date(paste(sub(".*_", "", period), sub("_.*", "", period), "15", sep = "-")))
  cov_season <- as.character(info$season)
  target <- season_order[(match(cov_season, season_order) %% 4) + 1]
  list(period = period, covariate_season = cov_season, covariate_year = info$year_adj,
       target_season = target, target_year = if (target == "Summer") info$year_adj + 1 else info$year_adj)
}
time_varying <- covariate_rasters[setdiff(names(covariate_rasters), "soil_group")]
forecast <- period_seasons(latest_shared_period(time_varying))
nowcast_rasters <- time_varying
nowcast_rasters$gpp_rolling6 <- gpp_rolling_raster_6_nowcast
nowcast_rasters$soil_moisture_anomaly <- soil_moisture_anomaly_raster_nowcast
nowcast <- period_seasons(latest_shared_period(nowcast_rasters))

## Current risk by AE zone, for both models: mean, 90th percentile and maximum across each zone's cells.
zone_raster <- terra::rasterize(terra::vect(fit_zones_ll), plague_risk_map_supervised, field = "ae_zone")
risk_by_zone <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  z <- terra::zonal(m$risk_map, zone_raster,
                    fun = function(x, ...) c(mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), q90 = stats::quantile(x, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
                                             max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  tibble::tibble(Model = label, ae_zone = as.character(z[[1]]), mean = z[[2]][, 1], q90 = z[[2]][, 2], max = z[[2]][, 3])
})
top_zones <- risk_by_zone |> filter(Model == "Supervised") |> arrange(desc(mean)) |> slice_head(n = 2)

## What drives each cell's onset risk: the entry formula's linear predictor split into one contribution
## per covariate (coefficient x value, with the zone's random slope added to its covariate) plus a
## baseline (intercept + the zone's random intercept). Covariates are centred levels or anomalies, so a
## contribution reads as the push away from an average season. Checked against hmmTMB's own prediction.
decompose_entry <- function(hmm, nd) {
  fe <- hmm$hid()$coeff_fe()[, 1]
  fe <- fe[startsWith(names(fe), "S1>S2.")]
  names(fe) <- sub("^S1>S2\\.", "", names(fe))
  re <- hmm$hid()$coeff_re()[, 1]
  re <- re[startsWith(names(re), "S1>S2.")]
  names(re) <- sub("^S1>S2\\.", "", names(re))
  zone_index <- match(as.character(nd$ae_zone), zone_levels)
  out <- list()
  ## Fixed effects: numeric main effects only (the entry formula has no factor terms).
  for (term in setdiff(names(fe), "(Intercept)")) {
    if (!is.numeric(nd[[term]])) stop("decompose_entry(): only numeric main effects are handled, not ", term)
    out[[sub("_scaled$", "", term)]] <- unname(fe[[term]] * nd[[term]])
  }
  ## Zone random slopes, added to their covariate's contribution.
  slope_names <- names(re)[grepl("^s\\(ae_zone\\):", names(re))]
  for (v in unique(sub("^s\\(ae_zone\\):(.*)\\.[0-9]+$", "\\1", slope_names))) {
    key <- sub("_scaled$", "", v)
    slope <- unname(re[paste0("s(ae_zone):", v, ".", zone_index)]) * nd[[v]]
    out[[key]] <- if (is.null(out[[key]])) slope else out[[key]] + slope
  }
  ## Baseline: intercept plus the zone's random intercept.
  out$baseline <- unname(fe[["(Intercept)"]] + re[paste0("s(ae_zone).", zone_index)])
  as.data.frame(out)
}
forecast_drivers <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  grid <- build_risk_grid_newdata(m$hmm, covariate_rasters, prediction_region_sf, forecast$period)
  contributions <- decompose_entry(m$hmm, grid$newdata)
  onset <- m$hmm$predict(what = "tpm", newdata = grid$newdata)["state 1", "state 2", ]
  ## The contributions must add up to hmmTMB's own logit Pr(enter plague).
  stopifnot(max(abs(rowSums(contributions) - stats::qlogis(onset))) < 1e-6)
  tibble::tibble(Model = label, ae_zone = as.character(grid$newdata$ae_zone), onset = onset) |>
    bind_cols(contributions)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: compute-transitions
#| include: false

## Transition covariates in either model.
entry_covariates <- unique(unlist(lapply(model_variants, function(m) transition_vars(m$hmm, TRUE))))
exit_covariates  <- unique(unlist(lapply(model_variants, function(m) transition_vars(m$hmm, FALSE))))

## Each covariate varied over its 5th-95th percentile, others typical, with 95% intervals, for every
## model and transition it enters.
transition_curves <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(unique(c(entry_covariates, exit_covariates)), function(cv) {
    values <- seq(stats::quantile(hmm_data[[cv]], 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), stats::quantile(hmm_data[[cv]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 40)
    p <- predict_ci(m$hmm, "tpm", transition_newdata(m$hmm, cv, values))
    tibble::tibble(Model = label, covariate = cv, value = rep(values, 2),
                   transition = rep(c("Entering plague", "Leaving plague"), each = length(values)),
                   mle = c(p$mle["state 1", "state 2", ], p$mle["state 2", "state 1", ]),
                   lcl = c(p$lcl["state 1", "state 2", ], p$lcl["state 2", "state 1", ]),
                   ucl = c(p$ucl["state 1", "state 2", ], p$ucl["state 2", "state 1", ])) |>
      ## Only the transition(s) this covariate enters in this model.
      filter((transition == "Entering plague" & cv %in% transition_vars(m$hmm, TRUE)) |
             (transition == "Leaving plague" & cv %in% transition_vars(m$hmm, FALSE)))
  })
})

## Effect sizes: each transition probability at the covariate's 10th and 90th percentiles, others typical.
effect_sizes <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(unique(c(entry_covariates, exit_covariates)), function(cv) {
    values <- stats::quantile(hmm_data[[cv]], c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
    p <- m$hmm$predict(what = "tpm", newdata = transition_newdata(m$hmm, cv, values))
    tibble::tibble(Model = label, covariate = cv, transition = c("Entering plague", "Leaving plague"),
                   low = c(p["state 1", "state 2", 1], p["state 2", "state 1", 1]),
                   high = c(p["state 1", "state 2", 2], p["state 2", "state 1", 2])) |>
      filter((transition == "Entering plague" & cv %in% transition_vars(m$hmm, TRUE)) |
             (transition == "Leaving plague" & cv %in% transition_vars(m$hmm, FALSE)))
  })
}) |>
  mutate(change = high - low)

## The strongest drivers of each transition in the supervised model, for the Summary.
top_driver <- function(tr) {
  e <- filter(effect_sizes, Model == "Supervised", transition == tr) |> arrange(desc(abs(change)))
  paste0(tolower(label_of(e$covariate[1])), " (", if (e$change[1] > 0) "+" else "", round(100 * e$change[1]), " points from its 10th to 90th percentile)")
}

## Transition probabilities in a typical season: every covariate at its median, in the reference zone.
typical_rates <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  p <- predict_ci(m$hmm, "tpm", transition_newdata(m$hmm, "min_temp", stats::median(hmm_data$min_temp)))
  tibble::tibble(Model = label,
                 enter = p$mle["state 1", "state 2", 1], enter_lcl = p$lcl["state 1", "state 2", 1], enter_ucl = p$ucl["state 1", "state 2", 1],
                 leave = p$mle["state 2", "state 1", 1], leave_lcl = p$lcl["state 2", "state 1", 1], leave_ucl = p$ucl["state 2", "state 1", 1])
})
```

```{r}
#| label: compute-observations
#| include: false

## The observation term specification (r/e_fit_plague_hmm.R): each stream's main parameter and the
## hmm_data columns that hold its observations.
stream_info <- tibble::tribble(
  ~spec,          ~param,  ~stream,          ~stream_label,
  "trap_count",   "mean",  "trap_count",     "Live traps: captures per 100 trap-nights",
  "burrow_count", "mean",  "burrow_count",   "Active burrows per 100 m transect",
  "chewcard",     "prob",  "chewcard_count", "Chew cards: probability a card is chewed"
)
## Typical conditions per stream (from that stream's own surveys), with search effort set to 100 trap-nights
## or 100 m of transect so means read per unit of effort.
stream_base_row <- function(stream) {
  observed <- if (stream == "chewcard_count") Reduce(`|`, lapply(chewcard_streams, function(s) !is.na(hmm_data[[s]]))) else !is.na(hmm_data[[stream]])
  row <- typical_row(hmm_data, observed)
  row$log_trap_effort <- log(100)
  row$log_burrow_metres_searched <- log(100)
  row
}

## How strongly each stream separates the states: its expected value in each state at typical
## conditions (95% interval), and the chance a survey finds nothing (zero count) in each state.
stream_contrast <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  purrr::pmap_dfr(stream_info, function(spec, param, stream, stream_label) {
    nd <- stream_base_row(stream)
    p <- predict_ci(m$hmm, "obspar", nd)
    par_name <- paste0(stream, ".", param)
    value <- function(arr, state) arr[par_name, state, 1]
    ## Probability of a zero from the stream's own family, at each state's fitted parameters.
    pdf <- m$hmm$obs()$dists()[[stream]]$pdf()
    pr_zero <- sapply(1:2, function(s) {
      pars <- p$mle[startsWith(rownames(p$mle), paste0(stream, ".")), s, 1]
      names(pars) <- sub(paste0("^", stream, "\\."), "", names(pars))
      do.call(pdf, c(list(x = 0), as.list(pars)))
    })
    ## Trap and burrow means are per unit of effort at 100 trap-nights / 100 m; chew-card prob is per card.
    tibble::tibble(Model = label, Stream = stream_label,
                   not_plague = value(p$mle, 1), not_plague_lcl = value(p$lcl, 1), not_plague_ucl = value(p$ucl, 1),
                   plague = value(p$mle, 2), plague_lcl = value(p$lcl, 2), plague_ucl = value(p$ucl, 2),
                   zero_not_plague = pr_zero[1], zero_plague = pr_zero[2])
  })
})
```

```{r}
#| label: compute-detection
#| include: false

## Crop stages in growth order, for the detection-effect panels.
crop_stage_order <- c("sown", "seedling", "vegetative", "flowering", "ripening", "stubble", "not recorded")

## Detection effects: each stream's observation terms, one panel per covariate, at typical conditions
## for that stream, not-plague state, with 95% intervals. Panels come from the specification itself: a
## factor shows each level; a numeric covariate a curve over its 5th-95th percentile; a two-way
## interaction is drawn as the first variable split by the second (e.g. season by cropping system).
detection_panels <- function(stream_spec) {
  terms_vec <- stream_spec[[setdiff(names(stream_spec), c("family", "state_specific"))[1]]]
  ## Offsets and the intercept aren't detection effects.
  terms_vec <- terms_vec[!grepl("^offset\\(", terms_vec) & terms_vec != "1"]
  labels <- attr(stats::terms(stats::as.formula(paste("~", paste(terms_vec, collapse = " + ")))), "term.labels")
  pairs <- strsplit(labels[grepl(":", labels)], ":", fixed = TRUE)
  ## Variables drawn as the split of an interaction get no panel of their own.
  partners <- vapply(pairs, `[`, "", 2)
  mains <- setdiff(labels[!grepl(":", labels)], partners)
  c(lapply(pairs, function(p) list(var = p[1], by = p[2])),
    lapply(setdiff(mains, vapply(pairs, `[`, "", 1)), function(v) list(var = v, by = NA_character_)))
}
detection_effects <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  purrr::pmap_dfr(stream_info, function(spec, param, stream, stream_label) {
    base <- stream_base_row(stream)
    observed <- if (stream == "chewcard_count") Reduce(`|`, lapply(chewcard_streams, function(s) !is.na(hmm_data[[s]]))) else !is.na(hmm_data[[stream]])
    rows <- purrr::map_dfr(detection_panels(hmm_observation_model[[spec]]), function(pnl) {
      raw_var <- sub("_scaled$", "", pnl$var)
      ## x values: each factor level seen in this stream's surveys, or a numeric grid in real units.
      x_values <- if (is.factor(hmm_data[[pnl$var]])) {
        observed_levels <- levels(droplevels(hmm_data[[pnl$var]][observed]))
        ## Crop stages in growth order rather than alphabetically.
        if (all(observed_levels %in% crop_stage_order)) intersect(crop_stage_order, observed_levels) else observed_levels
      } else {
        seq(stats::quantile(hmm_data[[raw_var]][observed], 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            stats::quantile(hmm_data[[raw_var]][observed], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 25)
      }
      by_values <- if (is.na(pnl$by)) NA_character_ else levels(droplevels(hmm_data[[pnl$by]][observed]))
      tidyr::expand_grid(x = as.character(x_values), by = by_values) |>
        mutate(panel = label_of(raw_var), var = pnl$var, raw_var = raw_var, by_var = pnl$by,
               numeric = !is.factor(hmm_data[[pnl$var]]))
    })
    ## One prediction row per x (and split) value, everything else typical.
    nd <- base[rep(1, nrow(rows)), , drop = FALSE]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
      if (rows$numeric[i]) nd[[rows$raw_var[i]]][i] <- as.numeric(rows$x[i]) else nd[[rows$var[i]]][i] <- rows$x[i]
      if (!is.na(rows$by_var[i])) nd[[rows$by_var[i]]][i] <- rows$by[i]
    }
    for (v in names(nd)) if (is.factor(hmm_data[[v]])) nd[[v]] <- factor(as.character(nd[[v]]), levels = levels(hmm_data[[v]]))
    nd <- scale_covariates(nd, attr(m$hmm, "covariate_scaling"))
    p <- predict_ci(m$hmm, "obspar", nd)
    par_name <- paste0(stream, ".", param)
    ## Trap captures per 100 trap-nights and burrows per 100 m (effort set to 100 above); chew cards per card.
    rows |>
      mutate(Model = label, Stream = stream_label,
             mle = p$mle[par_name, 1, ], lcl = p$lcl[par_name, 1, ], ucl = p$ucl[par_name, 1, ])
  })
})

## One stream's detection-effect figure: categorical panels as points with intervals, numeric panels
## as curves with bands; a split variable (e.g. cropping system, soil group) by shape or line type.
plot_detection <- function(stream_label) {
  d <- filter(detection_effects, Stream == stream_label) |>
    mutate(split = ifelse(is.na(by), "none", paste0(label_of(by_var), ": ", by)))
  categorical <- filter(d, !numeric)
  continuous <- filter(d, numeric)
  plots <- list()
  if (nrow(categorical) > 0) {
    ## x categories keyed by panel, so each panel keeps its own level order (e.g. "not recorded" last
    ## for crop stage even though it comes earlier for crop group); the panel prefix is dropped from labels.
    categorical <- mutate(categorical, x_key = factor(paste(panel, x, sep = "|"), levels = unique(paste(panel, x, sep = "|"))))
    plots$categorical <- ggplot(categorical, aes(x_key, mle, colour = Model, shape = split)) +
      geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.25) +
      facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours, name = NULL) +
      ## Unsplit panels are drawn but left out of the legend.
      scale_shape_discrete(breaks = setdiff(unique(categorical$split), "none")) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = function(k) sub("^.*\\|", "", k)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = stream_label, shape = NULL) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, size = 7.5), legend.position = "top")
  }
  if (nrow(continuous) > 0) {
    plots$continuous <- ggplot(continuous, aes(as.numeric(x), mle, colour = Model, fill = Model, linetype = split)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl, group = interaction(Model, split)), colour = NA, alpha = 0.12) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
      facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours, name = NULL) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = model_colours, name = NULL) +
      scale_linetype_discrete(breaks = setdiff(unique(continuous$split), "none")) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = stream_label, linetype = NULL) +
      theme(legend.position = "top")
  }
  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1, heights = if (length(plots) == 2) c(2, 1) else 1)
}

## Example paddocks: in each state, the paddock with the most surveyed seasons, its observations per
## unit of effort and each model's smoothed Pr(plague).
season_mid_month <- c(Summer = 1L, Autumn = 4L, Winter = 7L, Spring = 10L)
state_probs <- lapply(model_variants, function(m) m$hmm$state_probs()[, "state2"])
panel_dates <- as.Date(paste(hmm_data$year_adj, season_mid_month[as.character(hmm_data$season)], "15", sep = "-"))
surveyed <- !is.na(hmm_data$trap_count) | !is.na(hmm_data$burrow_count) | !is.na(hmm_data$chewcard_count)
example_ids <- hmm_data |>
  mutate(surveyed = surveyed) |>
  group_by(aus_state, ID) |>
  summarise(n = sum(surveyed), streams = (any(!is.na(trap_count)) + any(!is.na(burrow_count)) + any(!is.na(chewcard_count))), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(streams), desc(n)) |>
  group_by(aus_state) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
example_rows <- hmm_data$ID %in% example_ids$ID
example_data <- tibble::tibble(
  ID = hmm_data$ID, aus_state = hmm_data$aus_state, date = panel_dates, state = hmm_data$state,
  Supervised = state_probs$Supervised, Unsupervised = state_probs$Unsupervised,
  `Captures per 100 trap-nights` = 100 * hmm_data$trap_count / hmm_data$trap_effort,
  `Active burrows per 100 m` = 100 * hmm_data$burrow_count / hmm_data$burrow_metres_searched,
  `Share of cards chewed` = hmm_data$chewcard_count / 10,
  surveyed = surveyed
)[example_rows, ] |>
  mutate(paddock = paste0(aus_state, " paddock ", ID)) |>
  ## Each paddock's window: a year either side of its surveyed seasons.
  group_by(paddock) |>
  filter(date >= min(date[surveyed]) - 365, date <= max(date[surveyed]) + 365) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: compute-skill
#| include: false

## Hindcast skill (state-mean summary), both models.
hindcast_scores <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) mutate(m$hindcast_scores$scores, Model = label)) |>
  filter(stat == "mean")
get_hindcast <- function(model, predictor_name, era_name, col = "auc_within") {
  hindcast_scores[[col]][hindcast_scores$Model == model & hindcast_scores$predictor == predictor_name & hindcast_scores$era == era_name]
}

## Hindcast skill by state: AUC of each state's own flagged against unflagged years, before 2013.
state_skill <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  m$hindcast_scores$state_year |>
    filter(era == "hindcast", !is.na(flag)) |>
    group_by(state) |>
    summarise(Flagged = sum(flag), Years = n(),
              `Onset, one year ahead` = hindcast_auc(onset_lead_mean, flag),
              `Onset, same year` = hindcast_auc(onset_mean, flag),
              Occupancy = hindcast_auc(occupancy_mean, flag), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(Model = label)
})
sup_state_skill <- filter(state_skill, Model == "Supervised")
skilled_states <- sup_state_skill$state[sup_state_skill$`Onset, one year ahead` >= 0.75]
weak_states <- sup_state_skill$state[sup_state_skill$`Onset, one year ahead` < 0.6]

## Residual calibration and posterior-predictive statistics outside the simulated range.
pr_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(plague_hmm_pseudores, function(x, nm) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  tibble::tibble(Stream = nm, n = length(x), Mean = mean(x), SD = sd(x), `% |z|>2` = 100 * mean(abs(x) > 2))
})
ppc_summary <- plague_hmm_ppc$simulated |>
  group_by(statistic) |>
  summarise(sim_mean = mean(simulated), sim_lo = quantile(simulated, 0.025), sim_hi = quantile(simulated, 0.975), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(plague_hmm_ppc$observed, by = "statistic") |>
  mutate(inside = observed >= sim_lo & observed <= sim_hi)
ppc_outside <- ppc_summary$statistic[!ppc_summary$inside]
ppc_label <- function(stat) {
  stream <- c(trap_count = "trap", burrow_count = "burrow", chewcard_count = "chew-card")[sub(":.*", "", stat)]
  what <- dplyr::recode(sub(".*: ", "", stat), mean = "mean", SD = "SD", `Pr(0)` = "share of zeros", `Pr(10)` = "share of fully chewed sessions")
  paste(stream, what)
}

## Panel size, anchors and the mapped plague seasons.
n_rows     <- nrow(hmm_data)
n_paddocks <- n_distinct(hmm_data$ID)
fit_states <- sort(unique(hmm_data$aus_state))
n_plague    <- sum(hmm_data$state == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
n_nonplague <- sum(hmm_data$state == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
mapped_seasons <- recent_plague_maps |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  distinct(season, year) |>
  arrange(year, match(season, season_order))
first_mapped_year <- min(mapped_seasons$year)

## Decoded-state agreement and second-state shares.
decoded <- lapply(model_variants, function(m) m$hmm$viterbi())
agreement_pct <- round(100 * mean(decoded$Supervised == decoded$Unsupervised), 1)
state2_share <- sapply(decoded, function(v) mean(v == 2))
```

## Summary

- **Current forecast.** For `r forecast$target_season` `r forecast$target_year` (from `r forecast$covariate_season` `r forecast$covariate_year` covariates), the supervised model's onset risk is highest in `r top_zones$ae_zone[1]` (zone mean `r pct(top_zones$mean[1])`) and `r top_zones$ae_zone[2]` (`r pct(top_zones$mean[2])`).
- **What drives plagues.** Entry into plague responds most to `r top_driver("Entering plague")`; leaving plague responds most to `r top_driver("Leaving plague")`. In a typical season a paddock has a `r pct(typical_rates$enter[1])` chance of entering plague and a plague a `r pct(typical_rates$leave[1])` chance of ending, an average plague length of about `r round(1 / typical_rates$leave[1], 1)` seasons.
- **What the surveys say.** In a plague, the expected trap catch is `r round(stream_contrast$plague[1] / stream_contrast$not_plague[1], 1)` times, and burrow counts `r round(stream_contrast$plague[2] / stream_contrast$not_plague[2], 1)` times, their not-plague levels; a chew card is `r round(stream_contrast$plague[3] / stream_contrast$not_plague[3], 1)` times as likely to be chewed.
- **Forecast skill varies by region.** On recorded plague years before 2013, which the model never saw, one-year-ahead onset risk separates plague from non-plague years well in `r and_join(skilled_states)` (AUC ≥ 0.75)`r if (length(weak_states) > 0) paste0(" but poorly in ", and_join(weak_states), " (AUC < 0.6)") else ""`; the overall within-state AUC is `r fmt2(get_hindcast("Supervised", "onset_lead", "hindcast"))`.
- **Model checks.** Randomised residuals are calibrated for every stream (means `r fmt2(min(pr_summary$Mean))` to `r fmt2(max(pr_summary$Mean))`, SDs `r fmt2(min(pr_summary$SD))` to `r fmt2(max(pr_summary$SD))`). `r if (length(ppc_outside) > 0) paste0("Data simulated from the model match the real data except for the ", and_join(ppc_label(ppc_outside)), ".") else "Data simulated from the model match every checked statistic."`
- **Supervised vs. unsupervised.** Fitted with and without the plague-map anchors, the two models agree on `r agreement_pct`% of decoded states; without anchors the second state covers `r pct(state2_share[["Unsupervised"]])` of paddock-seasons against `r pct(state2_share[["Supervised"]])`.
- **Data.** `r format(n_rows, big.mark = ",")` paddock-seasons across `r n_paddocks` paddocks in `r length(fit_states)` states, `r format(n_plague, big.mark = ",")` anchored to plague and `r format(n_nonplague, big.mark = ",")` to not-plague from `r nrow(mapped_seasons)` hand-mapped plague seasons since `r first_mapped_year`.

## Current forecast

**The maps forecast `r forecast$target_season` `r forecast$target_year`**, from `r forecast$covariate_season` `r forecast$covariate_year` covariates (layer `r forecast$period`): the probability that a paddock not in plague now is in plague next season. They cover the prediction region, the fitted AE zones cut to SA2 cropping land plus 25 km around every surveyed paddock (`r/e_build_prediction_region.R`). The forecast reaches one season ahead only, since every covariate is built from observed data.

### What is driving the forecast

Zones ordered by supervised risk, with each model's zone-mean risk in brackets."

zone_order <- driver_summary |> filter(Model == "Supervised") |> distinct(ae_zone, onset) |> arrange(onset) |> pull(ae_zone)

Anomalies and rainfall whiplash use a diverging scale (white = average); GPP and minimum temperature are levels. Colour limits span each covariate's full record, so colours are comparable between forecasts.")

## Each covariate's layer for the forecast period (static soil group as is), masked to the prediction region.
region_vect <- terra::vect(prediction_region_ll)
covariate_maps <- purrr::imap(covariate_rasters, function(r, cv) {
  stack <- terra::mask(r, region_vect)
  layer <- if (terra::nlyr(stack) == 1) stack else stack[[forecast$period]]
  df <- as.data.frame(layer, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(df)[3] <- "value"
  if (cv == "soil_group") {
    ## Soil group: a categorical raster stored as labels or level positions.
    if (is.numeric(df$value)) df$value <- levels(hmm_data$soil_group)[df$value]
    scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = c("cracking clay" = "#8c510a", "duplex/calcareous loam" = "#d8b365", "sandy earth" = "#5ab4ac"), name = NULL)
  } else {
    rng <- terra::global(stack, "range", na.rm = TRUE)
    lim <- c(min(rng$min, na.rm = TRUE), max(rng$max, na.rm = TRUE))
    scale <- if (cv %in% c("gpp_rolling6", "min_temp")) {
      scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = lim, name = NULL)
    } else {
      scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"), values = c(0, scales::rescale(0, from = lim), 1), limits = lim, name = NULL)
    }
  }
  grid_map(df, "value", scale, label_of(cv)) + theme(legend.key.width = unit(0.9, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
})
patchwork::wrap_plots(covariate_maps, ncol = 3)
```

### Nowcast and uncertainty

The forecast map changes only at season boundaries (February, May, August, November), because GPP and soil moisture are season-end values. The nowcast reads every covariate at the latest complete month (`r nowcast$period`), forecasting `r nowcast$target_season` `r nowcast$target_year`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-risk-map-nowcast
#| fig-cap: !expr paste0("Nowcast of Pr(not-plague → plague) using covariates at ", nowcast$period, ". Same scale as the forecast map.")
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-asp: 0.4

risk_maps_nowcast <- purrr::imap(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  df <- as.data.frame(m$risk_map_nowcast, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(df)[3] <- "risk"
  grid_map(df, "risk", risk_scale, label)
})
patchwork::wrap_plots(risk_maps_nowcast, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-risk-map-uncertainty
#| fig-cap: "Width of the 95% interval for the forecast map, on the logit scale (a probability-scale width looks small whenever risk is near 0% or 100%, however uncertain the estimate). From 500 posterior draws of each model's coefficients. Darker = less certain."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-asp: 0.4

uncertainty_dfs <- purrr::imap(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  ## Logit written out, since stats::qlogis() doesn't accept a SpatRaster but raster arithmetic does.
  logit <- function(p) log(p / (1 - p))
  width <- logit(m$risk_map_uncertainty[["ucl"]]) - logit(m$risk_map_uncertainty[["lcl"]])
  df <- as.data.frame(width, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(df)[3] <- "logit_width"
  df
})
uncertainty_scale <- scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Purples", direction = 1,
                                          limits = range(unlist(lapply(uncertainty_dfs, `[[`, "logit_width"))),
                                          name = "95% interval width (logit)")
uncertainty_maps <- purrr::imap(uncertainty_dfs, function(df, label) grid_map(df, "logit_width", uncertainty_scale, label))
patchwork::wrap_plots(uncertainty_maps, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Past seasons

Pr(plague) in every cell for earlier seasons, carried forward season by season from Summer `r min(plague_hindcast_supervised$year_adj)` through each season's transition matrix (`r/e_hindcast_plague_occurrence.R`). The grid uses the covariates only; the points are surveyed paddocks, coloured by each model's smoothed Pr(plague) given their own survey data and anchors. Outlines are the hand-mapped plague extents for that season (Mutze 1989 for 1984).

```{r}
#| label: past-seasons-prep
#| include: false

## Years shown: the two most recent, then major recorded plague years, where the hindcast covers them.
hindcast_years <- sort(unique(plague_hindcast_supervised$year_adj))
past_years <- unique(c(rev(tail(hindcast_years, 2)), intersect(c(2021, 2017, 2011, 1993, 1984), hindcast_years)))

## Paddock points: surveyed paddock-seasons with each model's smoothed Pr(plague).
paddock_points <- tibble::tibble(longitude = hmm_data$longitude, latitude = hmm_data$latitude,
                                 year_adj = hmm_data$year_adj, season = as.character(hmm_data$season),
                                 Supervised = state_probs$Supervised, Unsupervised = state_probs$Unsupervised)[surveyed, ] |>
  pivot_longer(c(Supervised, Unsupervised), names_to = "Model", values_to = "prob")

## Mapped plague extents with their season (Mutze's 1984 extents cover the whole year, so they're
## repeated in every 1984 season).
recent_extents <- recent_plague_maps |> st_transform(4326) |> st_make_valid()
mutze_1984_ll <- st_union(st_make_valid(st_transform(filter(mutze_plague_maps, year == 1984), 4326)))
extents <- rbind(
  st_sf(season = as.character(recent_extents$season), year = recent_extents$year, geometry = st_geometry(recent_extents)),
  st_sf(season = season_order, year = 1984, geometry = rep(mutze_1984_ll, length(season_order)))
)

## One year's maps: models in rows, seasons in columns.
past_year_map <- function(yr) {
  grid <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
    filter(m$hindcast, year_adj == yr) |> select(x, y, season, occupancy) |> mutate(Model = label)
  }) |>
    mutate(season = factor(season, levels = season_order))
  ## The extents repeated for each model's row of panels.
  yr_extents <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(model_variants), function(md) mutate(filter(extents, year == yr), Model = md))) |>
    mutate(season = factor(season, levels = season_order))
  pts <- filter(paddock_points, year_adj == yr) |> mutate(season = factor(season, levels = season_order))
  ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = grid, aes(x, y, fill = occupancy)) +
    geom_sf(data = aus_sf, fill = NA, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = yr_extents, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(data = pts, aes(longitude, latitude, fill = prob), shape = 21, size = 1.6, stroke = 0.3, colour = "black") +
    risk_scale +
    facet_grid(Model ~ season, drop = FALSE) +
    coord_sf(xlim = range(grid$x) + c(-0.5, 0.5), ylim = range(grid$y) + c(-0.5, 0.5), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(fill = "Pr(plague)") +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(1.4, "cm"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
```

### Specification

Every term below is read from the model specification in `_targets.R` (`hmm_observation_model`, `plague_transition_enter`, `plague_transition_leave`), so this table always matches the fitted model.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-spec-observation

## One row per observation term: its stream, family, parameter and how it is treated across states.
family_names <- c(nbinom2 = "Negative binomial", betabinom = "Beta-binomial", binom = "Binomial", zibinom = "Zero-inflated binomial")
term_treatment <- function(term, state_specific) {
  if (term == "1") return("Intercept only: one value per state")
  if (grepl("^offset\\(", term)) return("Offset: coefficient fixed at 1 (per unit of search effort)")
  if (any(all.vars(stats::as.formula(paste("~", term))) %in% state_specific)) return("Separate value in each state")
  "Shared by both states (detection effect)"
}
purrr::imap_dfr(hmm_observation_model, function(spec, stream) {
  params <- setdiff(names(spec), c("family", "state_specific"))
  purrr::map_dfr(params, function(param) {
    terms_vec <- spec[[param]]
    rows <- tibble::tibble(Term = terms_vec, Treatment = vapply(terms_vec, term_treatment, "", state_specific = spec$state_specific))
    ## Every parameter with covariates also has an intercept, one value per state.
    if (!identical(terms_vec, "1")) rows <- bind_rows(tibble::tibble(Term = "(intercept)", Treatment = "One value per state"), rows)
    mutate(rows, Stream = if (stream == "chewcard") "chewcard (all four blocks, every coefficient shared)" else stream,
           Family = family_names[[spec$family]], Parameter = param)
  })
}) |>
  mutate(Term = paste0("`", Term, "`")) |>
  select(Stream, Family, Parameter, Term, Treatment) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Stream") |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = Term) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.8em") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Observation model")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-spec-transition

## One row per transition term, with what it means and whether the unsupervised model uses it.
term_meaning <- function(term) {
  if (grepl("^s\\(ae_zone, by", term)) return(paste0("AE-zone random slope on ", sub("^s\\(ae_zone, by = ([^,]+),.*$", "\\1", term)))
  if (grepl("^s\\(ae_zone", term)) return("AE-zone random intercept")
  if (grepl(":", term)) return("Interaction (slope differs by soil group)")
  if (grepl("_scaled$", term)) return("Level, centred and scaled (r/e_scale_covariates.R)")
  if (grepl("anomaly", term)) return("Anomaly against the same time of year")
  if (term == "soil_group") return("Soil group (factor)")
  "Fixed effect"
}
bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(Transition = "Entering plague [1, 2]", Term = plague_transition_enter,
                 Unsupervised = "yes"),
  tibble::tibble(Transition = "Leaving plague [2, 1]", Term = plague_transition_leave,
                 Unsupervised = ifelse(plague_transition_leave %in% plague_transition_leave_unsupervised, "yes", "no"))
) |>
  mutate(Meaning = vapply(Term, term_meaning, ""), Term = paste0("`", Term, "`")) |>
  select(Transition, Term, Meaning, `In unsupervised model` = Unsupervised) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Transition") |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = Term) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.8em") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Transition model", subtitle = "This season's covariates set the transition to next season's state")
```

- **States and time step.** Two hidden states, one time series per paddock, one step per season; the initial distribution is the stationary one.
- **Families.** Trap and burrow counts are negative binomial; chew cards are beta-binomial, which lets cards within a session be chewed together. The beta-binomial comes from the patched hmmTMB build pinned in `renv.lock`.
- **Why the history of each term:** `r/e_fit_plague_hmm.R`.

### Data and anchoring

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data

## Surveys per state: paddocks, paddock-seasons, and paddock-seasons with each observation stream.
hmm_data |>
  group_by(State = aus_state) |>
  summarise(Paddocks = n_distinct(ID), `Paddock-seasons` = n(),
            `Live-trap` = sum(!is.na(trap_count)), `Active burrow` = sum(!is.na(burrow_count)),
            `Chew card` = sum(!is.na(chewcard_count)),
            `Anchored plague` = sum(state == 2, na.rm = TRUE), `Anchored not-plague` = sum(state == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(Paddocks)) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_integer(columns = -State) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label = "Paddock-seasons surveyed by", columns = c(`Live-trap`, `Active burrow`, `Chew card`)) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.85em")
```

Each paddock is one time series of seasons from `r min(hmm_data$year_adj)` to `r max(hmm_data$year_adj)`. Seasons without a survey stay in the panel with no observations, and repeat visits within a season are reduced to the first visit. `"Qld Central"` is excluded, having no surveys since 2008 and no plague anchors.

**Anchoring.** Known plague occurrence fixes the hidden state where it is known, from hand-digitised plague extents for each mapped season since `r first_mapped_year`. A paddock-season inside a mapped extent is anchored to plague. Outside the extents, a paddock-season is anchored to not-plague only in seasons with no plague mapped in its region (WA or the eastern states); otherwise the model estimates its state. The two seasons before a plague anchor are left unanchored, since a plague is rarely confirmed the season it begins. Full rule: `r/c_anchor_plague_state.R`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-anchor-maps
#| fig-cap: "The hand-digitised plague extents used as anchors, one panel per mapped season."
#| out-width: "100%"

knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root_path, recent_plague_maps_map))
```

## What drives plague onset and decline

Each covariate's effect on the chance of entering and of leaving plague, with the other covariates at their median, in `r reference_zone` (the zone closest to the average zone effect) and on `r common_soil_group` soils. Both models are shown; bands are 95% intervals.

```{r}
#| label: fig-entry-effects
#| fig-cap: !expr 'paste0("Pr(entering plague) per season as each entry covariate varies over its 5th-95th percentile, others at their median, in ", reference_zone, ". One row per model, each on its own scale. Bands: 95% intervals.")'
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-asp: 0.5

## One transition's curves: a row per model, each on its own y scale (the unsupervised second state is
## more common, so on a shared scale the supervised curves flatten), a column per covariate.
plot_transition_curves <- function(tr, y_label) {
  transition_curves |>
    filter(transition == tr) |>
    mutate(covariate_label = factor(label_of(covariate), levels = unique(label_of(covariate)))) |>
    ggplot(aes(value, mle, colour = Model, fill = Model)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), colour = NA, alpha = 0.18) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_grid(Model ~ covariate_label, scales = "free", labeller = labeller(covariate_label = label_wrap_gen(18))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours, guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_colours, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label)
}
plot_transition_curves("Entering plague", "Pr(entering plague) per season")
```

#| label: fig-exit-effects

#| fig-width: 11

plot_transition_curves("Leaving plague", "Pr(leaving plague) per season")

## Transition probabilities in a typical season, and what they imply.
typical_rates |>
  mutate(`Pr(enter plague)` = sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", pct(enter), pct(enter_lcl), pct(enter_ucl)),
         `Pr(leave plague)` = sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", pct(leave), pct(leave_lcl), pct(leave_ucl)),

```{r}
#| label: fig-whiplash-by-zone
#| fig-cap: "Pr(entering plague) as rainfall whiplash varies over its 5th-95th percentile in each AE zone (its zone-varying random slope), other covariates at their median."
#| fig-asp: 0.5

## Entry probability against whiplash in every zone, both models.
whiplash_values <- seq(stats::quantile(hmm_data$rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak, 0.05), stats::quantile(hmm_data$rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak, 0.95), length.out = 40)
whiplash_by_zone <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(zone_levels, function(zn) {
    p <- m$hmm$predict(what = "tpm", newdata = transition_newdata(m$hmm, "rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak", whiplash_values, zone = zn))
    tibble::tibble(Model = label, ae_zone = zn, value = whiplash_values, probability = p["state 1", "state 2", ])
  })
})
ggplot(whiplash_by_zone, aes(value, probability, colour = ae_zone)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Model, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "AE zone") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = label_of("rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak"), y = "Pr(entering plague) per season") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-exit-by-soil
#| fig-cap: "Supervised model: Pr(leaving plague) as rainfall whiplash and the soil-moisture anomaly vary, by soil group (their soil-group interactions on exit), other covariates at their median."
#| fig-asp: 0.45

## Exit probability by soil group for the covariates with soil-group interactions (supervised only).
soil_covariates <- intersect(c("rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak", "soil_moisture_anomaly"), transition_vars(plague_hmm, FALSE))
exit_by_soil <- purrr::map_dfr(soil_covariates, function(cv) {
  values <- seq(stats::quantile(hmm_data[[cv]], 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), stats::quantile(hmm_data[[cv]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 40)
  purrr::map_dfr(levels(hmm_data$soil_group), function(sg) {
    p <- predict_ci(plague_hmm, "tpm", transition_newdata(plague_hmm, cv, values, soil = sg))
    tibble::tibble(covariate = label_of(cv), soil_group = sg, value = values,
                   mle = p$mle["state 2", "state 1", ], lcl = p$lcl["state 2", "state 1", ], ucl = p$ucl["state 2", "state 1", ])
  })
})
soil_colours <- c("cracking clay" = "#8c510a", "duplex/calcareous loam" = "#d8b365", "sandy earth" = "#5ab4ac")
ggplot(exit_by_soil, aes(value, mle, colour = soil_group, fill = soil_group)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), colour = NA, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~covariate, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = soil_colours, name = "Soil group") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = soil_colours, name = "Soil group") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Pr(leaving plague) per season") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

## Candidate drivers considered for each transition

The candidate drivers of each transition, with the mechanism behind each and how it is measured. "In model" is read from the fitted formula.

```{r}
#| label: hypothesis-tables-prep

## Variables in the supervised model's formula for each transition.
enter_vars <- transition_vars(plague_hmm, TRUE)
leave_vars <- transition_vars(plague_hmm, FALSE)

## One hypothesis table: "In model" lists the formula variables matching each row's pattern.
hypothesis_table <- function(tbl, title, model_vars) {
  tbl |>
    mutate(`In model` = vapply(pattern, function(pt) {
      matched <- if (is.na(pt)) character(0) else grep(pt, model_vars, value = TRUE)
      if (length(matched) == 0) "--" else paste0("`", matched, "`", collapse = ", ")
    }, character(1))) |>
    select(Covariate, Mechanism, Measurement, `In model`) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::fmt_markdown(columns = `In model`) |>
    gt::tab_header(title = title) |>
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.85em") |>

}

## What the surveys tell the model

### How well each survey separates plague from not-plague

```{r}
#| label: tbl-stream-contrast

## Each stream's expected value in each state at typical conditions, and the chance of finding nothing.
fmt_value <- function(x, lo, hi, stream) {
  digits <- ifelse(grepl("probability", stream), 3, 2)
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f-%.", digits, "f)"), x, lo, hi)
}
stream_contrast |>
  mutate(`Not plague` = fmt_value(not_plague, not_plague_lcl, not_plague_ucl, Stream),
         Plague = fmt_value(plague, plague_lcl, plague_ucl, Stream),
         `Plague ÷ not plague` = sprintf("%.1f×", plague / not_plague),
         `Pr(nothing found), not plague` = pct(zero_not_plague, 1),
         `Pr(nothing found), plague` = pct(zero_plague, 1)) |>
  select(Stream, Model, `Not plague`, Plague, `Plague ÷ not plague`, starts_with("Pr(")) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Stream") |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.85em") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Expected survey result in each state",
                 subtitle = "At each stream's typical conditions (most common season, crop, soil and region; 100 trap-nights or 100 m of transect); 95% intervals")
```

The ratio is what lets a survey tell the states apart; the chance of finding nothing shows how often a single survey is uninformative. Because every detection term is shared by both states, the ratio is the same under any survey conditions for traps and burrows (on the log scale); for chew cards it holds on the odds scale.

### Detection effects

How survey conditions change what each stream records, in the not-plague state (the plague state follows the same pattern, scaled by the ratio above). Other conditions are held at their typical values; bands and bars are 95% intervals.

```{r}

    paste0("```{r}"),

    "#| fig-width: 11",

}

## Forecast skill

### Hindcast against recorded plague years

```{r}
#| label: hindcast-prep

hindcast_first <- plague_hindcast_supervised |>
  filter(!is.na(onset)) |>
  distinct(year_adj, season) |>
  arrange(year_adj, match(season, season_order)) |>
  slice(1)
hindcast_n         <- get_hindcast("Supervised", "onset", "hindcast", "n")
hindcast_n_flagged <- get_hindcast("Supervised", "onset", "hindcast", "n_flagged")
anchored_n         <- get_hindcast("Supervised", "onset", "anchored era", "n")
anchored_n_flagged <- get_hindcast("Supervised", "onset", "anchored era", "n_flagged")
```

Before 2013 there are no anchors and almost no surveys, so plague years recorded by state in `yearly_plague_occurrence.csv` are labels the model never saw. The hindcast runs the transitions over every grid cell from `r hindcast_first$season` `r hindcast_first$year_adj` (`r/e_hindcast_plague_occurrence.R`); each state's cells are averaged, and the highest season in each year is scored against that state-year's record (`r/e_score_plague_hindcast.R`). The main score is the within-state AUC: flagged and unflagged years compared within the same state, so differences in baseline risk between states don't count.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-state-skill

## AUC by state before 2013, both models.
state_skill |>
  arrange(state, Model) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "state") |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(`Onset, one year ahead`, `Onset, same year`, Occupancy), decimals = 2) |>
  gt::data_color(columns = c(`Onset, one year ahead`, `Onset, same year`, Occupancy), palette = "RdYlGn", domain = c(0.3, 1)) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.85em") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Hindcast skill by state, before 2013",
                 subtitle = "AUC of each state's recorded plague years against its other years (0.5 = no skill)")
```

ggplot(hindcast_series, aes(year_adj, onset_mean, colour = Model)) +

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-hindcast-scores

hindcast_scores |>
  filter(!(Model == "Unsupervised" & predictor == "rain_whiplash")) |>
  mutate(Model = ifelse(predictor == "rain_whiplash", "(covariate only)", Model),
         Predictor = recode(predictor, occupancy = "Occupancy", onset = "Onset, same year",
                            onset_lead = "Onset, one year ahead", rain_whiplash = "Rainfall whiplash alone"),
         Era = factor(recode(era, hindcast = "Before 2013 (unanchored)", `anchored era` = "2013 onwards (anchored)"),
                      levels = c("Before 2013 (unanchored)", "2013 onwards (anchored)")),
         `Within-state AUC (95% interval)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", auc_within, auc_within_lcl, auc_within_ucl),
         `Pooled AUC` = sprintf("%.2f", auc)) |>
  arrange(Era, Predictor, Model) |>
  select(Era, Predictor, Model, `Within-state AUC (95% interval)`, `Pooled AUC`) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Era") |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.85em") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Hindcast skill, all states", subtitle = "Intervals resample whole years")
```

- **Before 2013** (`r hindcast_n_flagged` flagged of `r hindcast_n` state-years), one-year-ahead onset scores `r fmt2(get_hindcast("Supervised", "onset_lead", "hindcast"))` (supervised) and `r fmt2(get_hindcast("Unsupervised", "onset_lead", "hindcast"))` (unsupervised), against `r fmt2(get_hindcast("Supervised", "rain_whiplash", "hindcast"))` for rainfall whiplash alone.
- **By state**, the warning works in the southern winter-cropping states and fails in the north: one-year-ahead AUC ranges from `r fmt2(min(sup_state_skill$"Onset, one year ahead"))` (`r sup_state_skill$state[which.min(sup_state_skill$"Onset, one year ahead")]`) to `r fmt2(max(sup_state_skill$"Onset, one year ahead"))` (`r sup_state_skill$state[which.max(sup_state_skill$"Onset, one year ahead")]`).
- **From 2013** only `r anchored_n_flagged` of `r anchored_n` state-years are flagged, too few to separate the models; these years are anchored in the supervised model but not in the unsupervised one.
- **Caveats.** The records are coarse (a whole state, a calendar year, no WA), and the rainfall-whiplash definition was chosen partly against the same records.

```{r}
#| label: mutze-1984

## Spot check against Mutze's (1989) mapped 1984 SA plague extent: do SA cells inside it get higher
## 1984 onset risk than SA cells outside it?
mutze_1984 <- sf::st_union(sf::st_make_valid(filter(mutze_plague_maps, year == 1984)))
sa_outline <- filter(aus_shp, ST_NAME == "SA")
mutze_check <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, model) {
  cells <- m$hindcast |>
    filter(year_adj == 1984, !is.na(onset)) |>
    group_by(cell, x, y) |>
    summarise(onset = max(onset), .groups = "drop")
  if (nrow(cells) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
  pts <- sf::st_as_sf(cells, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = sf::st_crs(aus_shp))
  in_sa <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(pts, sa_outline)) > 0
  inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(pts, sf::st_transform(mutze_1984, sf::st_crs(pts)))) > 0
  d <- cells[in_sa, ]
  d$inside <- inside[in_sa]
  tibble::tibble(Model = model, n_inside = sum(d$inside), onset_inside = mean(d$onset[d$inside]),
                 onset_outside = mean(d$onset[!d$inside]), auc = hindcast_auc(d$onset, as.integer(d$inside)))
})
mutze_text <- if (nrow(mutze_check) > 0) {
  paste0("**Mapped 1984 SA plague (Mutze 1989).** ", mutze_check$n_inside[1],
         " SA grain cells fall inside the mapped extent; their 1984 onset risk averages ",
         sprintf("%.3f", mutze_check$onset_inside[1]), " against ", sprintf("%.3f", mutze_check$onset_outside[1]),
         " elsewhere in SA (supervised), a cell-level AUC of ", fmt2(mutze_check$auc[1]),
         " (unsupervised ", fmt2(mutze_check$auc[2]), "). One mapped extent, so a spot check rather than a skill score.")
} else {
  "**Mapped 1984 SA plague (Mutze 1989)** falls before the first hindcast season."
}
```

`r mutze_text`

### Onset skill at paddock level

```{r}
#| label: onset-skill

## For each paddock-season not anchored to plague, does predicted Pr(enter plague) separate paddocks
## whose next season is anchored plague from those anchored not-plague? (The same anchors the
## supervised model was fitted to, so a consistency check rather than an out-of-sample test.)
eligible_by_model <- purrr::imap(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  p_enter <- m$hmm$predict(what = "tpm", newdata = hmm_data)["state 1", "state 2", ]
  hmm_data |>
    mutate(p_enter = p_enter) |>
    arrange(ID, season_year_adj) |>
    group_by(ID) |>
    mutate(next_state = lead(state)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(!is.na(next_state), is.na(state) | state != 2)
})
onset_skill <- purrr::imap_dfr(eligible_by_model, function(eligible, label) {
  yes <- eligible$p_enter[eligible$next_state == 2]
  no  <- eligible$p_enter[eligible$next_state == 1]
  tibble::tibble(Model = label, Onsets = length(yes), `Stayed clear` = length(no),
                 `Median Pr(enter) before onset` = median(yes), `Median Pr(enter) before staying clear` = median(no),
                 AUC = auc_fn(yes, no))
})
onset_skill |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_integer(columns = c(Onsets, `Stayed clear`)) |>
  gt::fmt_percent(columns = starts_with("Median"), decimals = 1) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = AUC, decimals = 3) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.85em")
```

```{r}
#| label: operational-threshold

## The risk cutoff that best separates onsets from non-onsets (Youden's J), supervised model.
sup_eligible <- eligible_by_model$Supervised
roc_points <- purrr::map_dfr(sort(unique(sup_eligible$p_enter)), function(th) {
  high <- sup_eligible$p_enter >= th
  onset <- sup_eligible$next_state == 2
  tibble::tibble(threshold = th, sensitivity = mean(high[onset]), specificity = mean(!high[!onset]))
})
best_threshold <- roc_points |>
  mutate(youden = sensitivity + specificity - 1) |>
  slice_max(youden, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
risk_values_sup <- terra::values(plague_risk_map_supervised)
pct_map_above <- 100 * mean(risk_values_sup[!is.na(risk_values_sup)] >= best_threshold$threshold)
```

A cutoff of **`r pct(best_threshold$threshold)`** best separates onsets from non-onsets in the supervised model, catching `r pct(best_threshold$sensitivity, 1)` of onsets while clearing `r pct(best_threshold$specificity, 1)` of seasons that stayed clear. `r round(pct_map_above, 1)`% of the current risk map is at or above it. It is a rough guide to where "elevated" starts on this model's scale, not an operational rule.

### Residuals

```{r}
#| label: tbl-residuals

pr_summary |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(Mean, SD, `% |z|>2`), decimals = 2) |>

Randomised quantile residuals (`r/e_randomised_pseudores.R`) compare each observation with the model's one-season-ahead forecast of it; for a well-specified model they are standard normal (mean 0, SD 1, about 5% beyond ±2).

## Supervised vs. unsupervised

The supervised model fixes the state wherever plague maps say it is known; the unsupervised model is the same model with no anchors, so its second state is whatever high-activity state the survey data and covariates support. Where the two agree, the anchors and the survey data tell the same story.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-comparison

tibble::tibble(
  Measure = c("Paddock-seasons decoded in state 2", "Decoded-state agreement between models",
              "Typical-season Pr(enter plague)", "Typical-season Pr(leave plague)",
              "Hindcast before 2013: onset, one year ahead", "Hindcast before 2013: onset, same year",
              "Hindcast before 2013: occupancy", "Paddock-level onset AUC (against the anchors)"),
  Supervised = c(pct(state2_share[["Supervised"]]), paste0(agreement_pct, "%"),
                 pct(typical_rates$enter[1]), pct(typical_rates$leave[1]),
                 fmt2(get_hindcast("Supervised", "onset_lead", "hindcast")), fmt2(get_hindcast("Supervised", "onset", "hindcast")),
                 fmt2(get_hindcast("Supervised", "occupancy", "hindcast")), fmt2(onset_skill$AUC[1])),
  Unsupervised = c(pct(state2_share[["Unsupervised"]]), "",
                   pct(typical_rates$enter[2]), pct(typical_rates$leave[2]),
                   fmt2(get_hindcast("Unsupervised", "onset_lead", "hindcast")), fmt2(get_hindcast("Unsupervised", "onset", "hindcast")),
                   fmt2(get_hindcast("Unsupervised", "occupancy", "hindcast")), fmt2(onset_skill$AUC[2]))
) |>

```{r}
#| label: fig-anchor-vs-model
#| fig-cap: "Each model's mean Pr(plague) across all paddocks in each state and year (highest season), with the share of anchored paddock-seasons in plague (points) where anchors exist."
#| fig-asp: 0.55

## Yearly maxima of state means, so the seasonal cycle doesn't hide the plague years.
anchor_vs_model <- hmm_data |>
  mutate(Supervised = state_probs$Supervised, Unsupervised = state_probs$Unsupervised,
         anchored = case_when(state == 2 ~ 1, state == 1 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
  group_by(aus_state, year_adj, season) |>
  summarise(anchored_share = mean(anchored, na.rm = TRUE), Supervised = mean(Supervised), Unsupervised = mean(Unsupervised), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(aus_state, year_adj) |>
  summarise(anchored_share = suppressWarnings(max(anchored_share, na.rm = TRUE)), Supervised = max(Supervised), Unsupervised = max(Unsupervised), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(anchored_share = ifelse(is.finite(anchored_share), anchored_share, NA))

ggplot(anchor_vs_model, aes(year_adj)) +
  geom_line(data = pivot_longer(anchor_vs_model, c(Supervised, Unsupervised), names_to = "Model"), aes(y = value, colour = Model), linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(y = anchored_share), colour = hazard_colors[5], size = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~aus_state, ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Pr(plague), state mean (highest season)") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

The covariate effects of the two models are compared directly in [What drives plague onset and decline](#what-drives-plague-onset-and-decline) and [Detection effects](#detection-effects).

## Limitations

```{r}
#| label: limitations-stats

## Near-singular joint precision (from collinear terms) makes the uncertainty sampling fall back to a
## generalised inverse; reported only if it occurs.
cond_numbers <- sapply(model_variants, function(m) {
  ev <- eigen(as.matrix(m$hmm$tmb_rep()$jointPrecision), symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
  max(ev) / min(ev)
})
```

- **Weak warning in the north.** `r if (length(weak_states) > 0) paste0("Before 2013, one-year-ahead onset risk does little better than chance in ", and_join(weak_states), " (@tbl-state-skill). The transition covariates and the anchors (few plague seasons mapped in the summer-cropping north) don't yet capture what starts plagues there.") else "Hindcast skill is similar across states (@tbl-state-skill)."`
- **Few independent plague events.** The plague transition rests on `r nrow(mapped_seasons)` mapped plague seasons; it improves only as more seasons are mapped.
- **One season ahead.** The covariates are observed data, so the forecast cannot extend beyond the season after the latest complete covariate period.
- **Coarse validation before 2013.** The hindcast is scored against state-by-year records with no WA coverage, and no anchors exist before `r first_mapped_year`.
- **Imperfect count distributions.** `r if (length(ppc_outside) > 0) paste0("Simulated data miss the ", and_join(ppc_label(ppc_outside)), ".") else "Simulated data match the checked statistics."`
- **Survey grids sharing coordinates.** Some sites surveyed two grids or transects on the same dates under one set of coordinates; cleaning keeps one of each pair, which can favour the busier grid (`r/a_clean_deduplicate_surveys.R`).
- **Patched hmmTMB.** The beta-binomial family comes from a patched hmmTMB (github.com/matt-w-rees/hmmTMB, pinned in `renv.lock`).
- `r if (any(cond_numbers > 1e12)) paste0("**Near-singular precision matrix** (condition number ", formatC(max(cond_numbers), format = "e", digits = 1), "): the uncertainty sampling falls back to a generalised inverse, which can understate interval widths along the affected directions.") else "**Uncertainty sampling** uses a well-conditioned precision matrix in both models."`

## Appendix

### Transition coefficients

```{r}
#| label: tbl-coeff

## Fixed-effect transition coefficients (logit scale), both models side by side.
purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  cf <- m$hmm$hid()$coeff_fe()
  tibble::tibble(Model = label, Parameter = rownames(cf), Estimate = cf[, 1])
}) |>
  mutate(Transition = ifelse(grepl("^S1>S2", Parameter), "Enter plague", "Leave plague"),
         Term = sub("^S[12]>S[12]\\.", "", Parameter)) |>
  select(-Parameter) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(Transition, Model), values_from = Estimate, names_sep = " | ") |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = -Term, decimals = 2) |>
  gt::sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "--") |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.8em") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Transition fixed effects (logit scale)",
                 subtitle = "\"_scaled\" covariates are per standard deviation; rainfall whiplash is the pooled slope, zone deviations below")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-zone-effects

## Zone random effects: intercept deviations and total rainfall-whiplash slopes, by model and transition.
zone_effects <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_variants, function(m, label) {
  re <- m$hmm$hid()$coeff_re()
  fe <- m$hmm$hid()$coeff_fe()
  rn <- rownames(re)
  is_slope <- grepl(":rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak_scaled\\.[0-9]+$", rn)
  tibble::tibble(
    Model      = label,
    Transition = ifelse(grepl("^S1>S2", rn), "Enter", "Leave"),
    ae_zone    = zone_levels[as.integer(sub(".*\\.", "", rn))],
    Effect     = ifelse(is_slope, "Whiplash slope", "Intercept deviation"),
    value      = re[, 1]
  ) |>
    mutate(value = ifelse(Effect == "Whiplash slope",
                          value + fe[paste0(ifelse(Transition == "Enter", "S1>S2", "S2>S1"), ".rain_whiplash_trough_to_peak_scaled"), 1],
                          value))
})
zone_effects |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(Effect, Transition, Model), values_from = value, names_sep = " | ") |>
  rename(`AE zone` = ae_zone) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = -`AE zone`, decimals = 2) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.72em") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "AE-zone effects on the transitions (logit scale)",
                 subtitle = "Intercept deviations from the pooled intercept, and each zone's total rainfall-whiplash slope")
```

### Onset risk by AE zone

```{r}
#| label: tbl-risk-zones

risk_by_zone |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = c(mean, q90, max), names_sep = " | ") |>
  arrange(desc(`mean | Supervised`)) |>
  rename(`AE zone` = ae_zone) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_percent(columns = -`AE zone`, decimals = 1) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.8em") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Onset risk by AE zone", subtitle = "Mean, 90th percentile and maximum across each zone's cells")
```

### Adjusted AE zones

The burrow and chew-card zone effects use `r length(adj_zone_levels)` adjusted AE zones, merging AE zones with few surveys (`r/a_adjust_aez.R`); the transitions keep all `r length(zone_levels)` original AE zones.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-obs-zones

hmm_data |>
  group_by(`Adjusted AE zone` = ae_zone_adj) |>
  summarise(`AE zones` = paste(sort(unique(as.character(ae_zone))), collapse = ", "),
            `Burrow surveys` = sum(!is.na(burrow_count)), `Chew-card surveys` = sum(!is.na(chewcard_count)),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "0.85em")
```
